semantics.lexical_return: A nested ^ match exits the enclosing callable, not its enclosing arm; all return arms must prove exhaustiveness and correct value type.
semantics.cancel: A successful pending cancel returns Err(Cancelled) when awaited. cancel does not consume the Future.
semantics.send_after_commit: Cancellation after a committed Some(value) must return AlreadySettled and preserve the message.
semantics.release: Explicit close, drain all queued messages and await outstanding Future owners before release.
semantics.host_abandon: Host-only abandon_read reclaims uncommitted pending reads/EOF tickets, but returns Busy for already-committed Some(value).
semantics.guest_auto_cleanup: NOT_IMPLEMENTED: no compiler-emitted host disposal across ^/return, throw, actor stop or unwinding; a v2/extended ABI and path-complete owner checking are required.

pending_cases.reason: The compiler currently allows an owned guest read Future to be abandoned at a nonlocal return; this is not an accepted passing case.

rust_browser_evidence.scope: Rust/Wasm browser guest + host adapter only. This CI run does not execute every portable fixture here or prove guest automatic Future cleanup.

evidence_rule: Never mark a backend PASS based on parser acceptance, host-only model, skipped differential, unexecuted fixture, foreign/backend CI or zero-runner-step workflow. Require exact backend SHA/tree, toolchain, real guest execution and negative diagnostics.
